cause: Cached human-owner motion kept overriding the AI render position, facing and walking state after disconnect.
fix: Remote owner poses apply only while a seat remains human-controlled; host stops echoing its old pose at AI handoff.
candidate_scope: Local uncommitted development build; no release published.
limitations: Native movement checks use a diagnostic build from this source with F12 probes; the packaged release separately passes signature, provenance, relocation and render checks.
The 3-peer LAN/TLS-QUIC tests check AI render position, facing and moving state on every remaining peer; live WAN uses 2 peers before departure.
